x_analysen.text: Gemini 4 Carbon costs $7.76 per Intelligence Index task, ~23% less than Claude Opus 5.5 (max, $10.04) but ~1.2x GPT-6 Astra (max, $6.25).
In Antigravity CLI, Gemini 4 Carbon scores 59 on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, behind only Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 (62).
GDPx is a true frontier-level benchmark: even the best model scores just 12%
